Synthos thought the sky empty, and made friends.

Clouds were beautiful. Billowing and coalescing. Their movement caused by the wind, and their rolling behaviour caused by the lands below pushing upwards. Wetness that was eventually going to fall to the ground, wetness that gave nutrients to plant life.

Something needed to exist within this beauty. A creature when born the size of a small cloud, a creature that could grow as large as the largest of clouds. Sky-whales. Magnificent beasts that would fly through the skies, pushing and pulling the clouds. Giving the wind something else to compete with.

The whales would populate the skies, as the first huge beast on the planet Ebos. They are tame creatures, and it would not take much to domesticate one. They are however quite intelligent.

They required food though, so Synthos created a very tiny creature. They would be known as Cloud Krill. A rich food source for the Sky-whales that looks and probably tastes like snow. One would need to eat many to survive, but it would ensure the Sky-whales would not overtake Ebos. By changing the Microbes to Krill, they have lost their ability to mutate other creatures, and are intact a new creature.
